notes.title: Depression The Game Patch Update 1.06i
notes.notes:
[h2]New Features [/h2][list][*] Launcher will restart the game to apply changes not possible on runtime

[*] Added options for OS priotization and the ability to choose which display the game should be launched on

[*] Subtitle text will now appear with a typing effect

[*] Added screenshot mode

[*] Walking is now accompanied by audible footsteps[/list][list][*] Indirect lighting now affects movable meshes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32994311/00457f4e8cb2df4cc1f5f2d3e6f00db9f485af47.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32994311/69be2efad9d74034b0431a515acf0735b3494a0a.png[/img]

[*] Reworked UI and polished menu[previewyoutube=ZmbmRfqh_m0;full]
[/previewyoutube]

[*] Modified Level Design[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32994311/8d2e63c26a7ef1f11eeb68d1e16994e5168eb90b.png[/img]
[/list]



[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*] Improved and fixed collisions of multiple meshes[*] Loading time has been reduced through optimization[*] Fixed bugs with the command prompt[*] Fixed bug occuring when changing screen resolution[*] Accuracy of API detection improved
[/list]

The [u]Patch[/u] will consider major updates for:[list]
[*] UI System
[*] Interaction System
[*] Movement System
[*] Overall Performance

The One way door loop will stay in the game.
